blogPosts.title: Preventing Blocked Drains in Prahran Homes: A Complete Guide
blogPosts.excerpt: Practical tips to keep your drains clear in Prahran, considering local factors like tree roots and Melbourne weather.
body: Blocked drains are a common nuisance in Prahran, where tree-lined streets and older housing can lead to pipe intrusions. Prevention starts with understanding the causes: grease, food scraps, hair, and foreign objects often clog kitchen and bathroom drains. In Prahran, heavy rainfall can overwhelm stormwater systems, causing backups. Regular maintenance, like monthly flushes with hot water, helps keep drains clear and avoids emergency call-outs.

Prahran's established gardens mean tree roots are a major issue, seeking moisture in pipes. Installing root barriers or choosing pipe relining can prevent intrusions. For Prahran residents, being mindful of what goes down the drain is crucial. Avoid pouring oil or coffee grounds in the sink, and use drain guards to catch debris. Educating your household on these habits reduces the risk of clogs and maintains plumbing health.

Melbourne's climate, with its dry spells followed by storms, can exacerbate drain issues. During dry periods, pipes may crack, and when rain returns, debris washes into drains.
